info.name: API Testing Showcase
info.description:
End-to-end API test suite showing advanced Postman techniques:
request chaining, collection/folder/request-level scripts, JWT + cookie auth,
JSON-schema contract tests, workflow loops with `pm.execution.setNextRequest`,
`pm.sendRequest` self-healing auth, business-logic assertions and data-driven runs.

APIs under test (public demo APIs): **Restful-Booker** and **DummyJSON**.
Run order matters: folders are designed to run top to bottom.

item.name: 02 Authentication
item.description:
Two auth styles side by side:
* **Restful-Booker** – token returned in the body, sent back as a `Cookie`.
* **DummyJSON** – JWT **Bearer** access token + refresh-token rotation.

Tokens are stored in collection variables and chained into every later request.

item.name: 03 Booking Lifecycle (E2E chain)
item.description:
A full CRUD journey where **every request depends on the one before it**:

`Create → Read → Search → Update (PUT) → Partial update (PATCH) → Delete → Verify deleted`

The expected state is kept in a collection variable and updated at each step, so every
response is compared with exactly what the API *should* hold at that moment.

item.name: 04 Negative & Authorization
item.description:
What the API must **refuse**: missing or invalid auth, unknown resources, bad payloads.
Requests prefixed `NEG` are allowed to return errors; the collection-level checks know this.
Known API defects are recorded with `pm.test.skip` so they show up in the report without failing the build.

item.name: NEG Create booking with missing required fields

05 Pagination & Workflow Control

* `pm.execution.setNextRequest()` loops the same request page by page until every product is collected,
  then checks that the total count matches and no product appears twice.
* Sorting and search are checked on the full result set, not just the first item.

item.name: 07 Data-Driven Bookings
item.description:
Runs once per row of `data/bookings.csv` (`npm run test:data`).
Each iteration creates a booking, verifies it and cleans it up, covering edge cases such as
apostrophes, accented names, zero deposit and very large prices.
Without a data file it falls back to one default row, so the full collection still runs.
